Education and Experience

Updated Training

One advantage of online training is that you can easily access it whenever you need a refresher or need to retake it for whatever purpose it may serve. Bottom line, never stop learning.

Specialized Field

The corporate world is wide and vast. You can’t just hop from one industry to another, hoping to get to the top by doing so. If you find something you’re good at, regardless of the industry, focus on it and make sure you grow professionally there. Have a specialization. It gives you greater efficiency, making you more sought after in a particular domain. Human Resource Context
